name: Ø Story
source:
In this interactive movie video game you play as a man who dies in a motorcycle accident. However, that is not the end for him as an Angel by the name Ai (Japanese for Love) gives him a second chance to live, but in order to get that chance he must make a girl named Rina, a popular J-Pop singer, fall in love with him within six days. The trick is, you are now but a spirit and are limited in a way you can interact with living people.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/64087/%C3%B8-story/]MobyGames[/url]]

In this interactive movie video game you play as a man who dies in a motorcycle accident. However, that is not the end for him as an Angel by the name Ai (Japanese for Love) gives him a second chance to live, but in order to get that chance he must make a girl named Rina, a popular J-Pop singer, fall in love with him within six days. The trick is, you are now but a spirit and are limited in a way you can interact with living people.
